description: 부산광역시_하수처리시설 월별 평균 수질현황 서비스 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산환경공단에서 운영하는 13개 하수처리장별 방류 수질 월별 평균 현황데이터를 개방합니다. 개방된 데이터는 대장균 방류/유입, BOD 방류/유입, COD 방류/유입, SS 방류/유입, T-N 방류/유입, TOC 방류/유입, T-P 방류/유입, 생태독성 방류/유입 수치가 연도별, 월별로 집계되어 있습니다... Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 오염, 수질, 하수도, 처리장, 대장균. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
